text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah……!
On a rainy day after school—I spotted Silence Suzuka running out on the track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah…… It had already started raining, hadn't it.
I didn't even notice……

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um…… thank you.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Suzuka-sa~n!
Come on, hurry! Let's get going quickly!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where to?
Did we make a promise……?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No no, not that!
It's just, before the rain starts, there's a good luck ritual I absolutely need you to do, Suzuka-san!
choice_data_list: If it's rain, it's already started pouring.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fungyaaaa~~!?
What did you sayyyy~~!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was so caught up thinking of the ritual that I didn't even look out the window…… What a catastrophic blunder!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um…… to begin with,
what do you mean by me doing a ritual……?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, you've been feeling down because you couldn't run due to all this non-stop rain, right?
You've been sighing every single day……

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So I came up with a sun-wishing ritual for clear skies! I wanted to cheer you up!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But it only works if we do it before the rain starts falling…… Uuugh, we didn't make it in time……!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
For my sake…… fufu, thank you.
Just knowing you care is enough.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No problem!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Praying for clear skies! That is a miracle that expands all possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So whether it's raining or not doesn't matter!
All you have to do is blast those rain clouds with PASSION!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's how sun rituals overseas work too!
The most crucial element is passion!
So, what do you say, Suzuka? Care to give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, an overseas ritual! What could that be like!
Suzuka-san! Which one will you choose!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
……Huh? How did it become a given that I'd do one of them……?
When did that happen……?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
U-Um…… what should I do……
Excuse me, which one would be better……?
choice_data_list: Since we're here, let's try Fukukitaru's ritual.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
!! I guarantee divine blessings, Suzuka-san!
Now, let's head outside right away~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed "this" from Windy-san!
Move it as if you're devouring the rain clouds and chant the spell!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um…… do I really have to do that……?
I-It's rather embarrassing……

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
N-Nam nam……!
Munch munch rain clouds, blazing bright sun……!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Peachy peachy great weather……!
Shine brightly, crystal clear skies……!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Away with you, Mr. Rain Cloud……!
Cozy warm, lovely blue skies, please come out……!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whooo~~!!
Nice passion!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's coming, it's coming, I feel it~!
Our prayers have reached the heavens above~~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
…………………………
……Could something like this really—ah.

Afterwards, perhaps because her prayer reached the skies,
the rain clouds vanished as though they had truly been devoured!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll make the rain stop!
Now, let's head to the track!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: W-What on earth is "this"……?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Explanations later! Just blast your passion for clear skies directly at the clouds! Let's start!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this Earth……!
S-Smile even more……!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Tears do not suit you……!
That's right, everyday sunny smile……!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Don't hide your smile behind rain clouds……!
Let's open mind, this Earth……!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whooo~~!!
Nice passion!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So this is an overseas clear sky ritual~!
I feel it~!
A tremendous spiritual aura!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
…………………………
……Could something like this really—ah.

Afterwards, perhaps because her prayer reached the skies,
a radiant sunny day spread out just like a passionate smile!
